sourceFacts.fact: The haemophilia genes are located on the X chromosome.
A male inherits his X chromosome from his mother and Y chromosome from his father.
A female with one altered copy is a carrier and can have bleeding symptoms.

labels: Xh = X with the haemophilia variant
forbiddenAnatomy: Organs, tissue layers, anatomical cutaways, histology, diagnostic scans, clinical photos

checks: Column maternal X and Xh; row paternal X and Y; all four cells combine correctly.
Female carrier is not called unaffected.
Probabilities refer to each pregnancy, not a guaranteed family of four.
